rationale: Both blocking findings from the final review are resolved. CR-001: 'subdir/..' added to traversal parametrize list, directly testing the workdir-exact-match boundary. CR-002: Two JOBS-mode integration tests added — one for CodeExecutorTool._execute_sandbox and one for WorkspaceScriptRunner._execute_sandbox_script — both confirm validation fires before the JOBS runner via AssertionError sentinel patches. Remaining fix-up changes are ruff reformats with no behavioral effect. Commit format conforms to EPMCDME-####: Description pattern. No new findings introduced. 18/18 tests pass (confirmed by test run in session).

business_review.criterion: Code Executor enforces file path whitelist only for sandbox execution
business_review.notes: Only sandbox execution paths exist in this tool; validation scoped to _execute_sandbox and _execute_sandbox_script.

business_review.criterion: Access to /proc, /etc, /sys, /var blocked in sandbox mode
business_review.notes: All four in _BLOCKED_EXPORT_PATH_PREFIXES; secondary gate covers equality and prefix.

business_review.criterion: Nested paths under blocked directories denied
business_review.notes: startswith(blocked + os.sep) covers all nested paths.

business_review.criterion: Path traversal attempts that resolve to blocked directories denied
business_review.notes: Primary workdir-containment gate blocks all escaping traversals before prefix check.
Relative in-workdir paths pass; falsy input is no-op.

business_review.criterion: Restriction does not affect non-sandbox modes
business_review.notes: No non-sandbox execution mode exists in this tool.

business_review.criterion: Controlled non-sensitive error response on denial
business_review.notes: Three ToolException messages include submitted path only, no internal state.

business_review.criterion: Automated tests cover allowed, blocked, nested blocked, and traversal cases
business_review.notes: 18 tests: 13 unit + 4 integration (SHARED and JOBS modes for both call sites) + 1 normalization. All pass.

business_review.criterion: Existing Code Executor behavior remains stable
business_review.notes: None/empty export_files returns immediately; existing tests unaffected.

standards_review.notes: Fix-up commit 'EPMCDME-13689: Fix code review findings CR-001 and CR-002' conforms to EPMCDME-####: Description format.
